method_note: Each selected point is copied unchanged from a government address source for the street address the operator publishes: the Digitaal Vlaanderen Geolocation API (Flemish base registers) for the two Belgian sites, the BEV Adressregister search for Graz, and the IBGE CNEFE 2022 municipal address files for the two ODATA Brazil sites (read from the ZIP in memory with Python -I; no file executed). For the Flemish points the served WGS84 values were checked against the served Lambert-72 (EPSG:31370) and Lambert-2008 (EPSG:3812) coordinates with pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 (always_xy): differences 0.001 m and 0.005 m. No offset, rounding or averaging was applied. No Google, Apple, Bing, HERE, Waze, Yandex or other commercial map coordinate, map link, embed, PeeringDB record or OpenStreetMap service was used.
displacement_formula: haversine, mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m (as in datacenter_atlas.dataset_update._distance_metres)
